PINILI Chairperson, PCSO Office of the Chairman 4F Sun Plaza Building, 1507 Princeton St., cor. Shaw Blvd. Mandaluyong City Dear Chairperson Pinili: This has reference to letter dated 08 July 2020 of Paulino G. Lalata, Jr., Pronvincial Director, DILG Pangasinan Provincial Office, requesting for this Department's legal opinion relative to the following, and we quote: 1. Is the operation of Globaltech Mobile Tech Online Corporation in the Province of Pangasinan authorized, legal, and lawful? 2. If legitimate and above-board, is the resumption of its operation during the Modified General Community Quarantine allowed by issuances of the National Inter-Agency Task Force for the Management of Emerging Infectious Disease especially from the Departments of Health, Trade and Industry, and the Interior and Local Government? and 3. If the concerned LGUs will not issue corresponding business permits, do they have the authority to close/shut down the offices and file the necessary charges in court if they still continue with their activity? As a brief background, the above queries arose because of the letter of Globaltech Mobile Online Corp. addressed to P/Colonel Rederico A. Maranan, Provincial Director, Philippine National Police, Pangasinan, informing the latter that they will resume the operation of "Peryahan ng Bayan Games" in the areas under General Community Quarantine (GCQ) and Modified General Community Quarantine (MGCQ) pursuant to the approved resolutions and guidelines on the implementation of community

quarantine in the country, specifically Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Memorandum Circular (MC) No. 20-22, series of 2020, dated 05 May 2020, and Executive Order No. 112, Series of 2020. Per verification, it appears that the PCSO issued its Board Resolution No. 51, Series of 2016 terminating the Deed of Authority of Globaltech on the grounds of several counts of under-remittance and non-remittance of sales. In this regard, we deem it prudent to seek your initial comments, specifically, the legality of operations of Globaltech as well as its status, for this Department to accordingly address the above enumerated issues. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to receive your comments/reaction on the matter the soonest possible time. Thank you. Very truly yours, BYA T ORITY OF THE SECRETARY: INGAN, CESO Ill etary for Local Government OIC- LegaV91 Copy Furnished: DIRECTOR JAMES F.
